fact: The Prime Minister told the National Assembly on 29 July 2025 that the back end of the Citizen Support Portal connects 583 ministries, departments, local authorities, parastatal bodies and some state-owned companies, and that tickets are transferred on the system to each organisation's designated desk officer or focal point, who must resolve them; no separate count of local authorities is given and the answer does not say where the officers work.

The Ministry of Local Government's annual report for 2024-2025 says its Land Use Planning Unit coordinates with the Economic Development Board and the local authorities on the National Electronic Licensing System for processing Building and Land Use Permit applications, and reports that the local authorities received 24,958 such applications and approved 13,453 between 1 July 2024 and 30 June 2025.

The Ministry's table of Building and Land Use Permit applications for 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025 lists all 12 local authorities (one municipal city council, four municipal town councils, seven district councils) of the 12 the report says the country has; the report names the National Electronic Licensing System as the system for processing these applications but does not itself say the table's figures passed through it or where the staff work.

The Ministry of Local Government's annual report for financial year 2023-2024 says its Digital Office works in real time with the twelve digital offices of the Local Authorities in the Council Project Management (CPM) system, in which all employees do their daily tasks in real time and can work remotely; it does not say where the system is hosted or how the offices are connected.
system: twelve digital offices of the Local Authorities, working in the Council Project Management (CPM) system

fact: The ministry says the I-Council project, piloted at the District Council of Moka from 27 August 2018 and extended by Government decision of 16 March 2020, took three years to implement in all Local Authorities, and that its Digital Office works in real time with twelve local authority digital offices: 12 of the 12 local authorities it counts (five municipal councils and seven district councils), stated in the report for financial year 2023-2024; the figure is of councils working online in the system, not of connections named as such.
